text.title: Ads Budget Optimization Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for Ads Budget Optimization: the five generic steps, then the monthly rebalance cycle (pacing check, reallocation decision matrix, incrementality before channel cuts) with the weekly-review and monthly-allocation templates. Each step lists input, action, output, and a decision-gate to the next step.

step.name: inventory-inputs
step.input: task brief, prior artefact (if any), source-of-truth access
step.action: Collect inputs named in AGENTS.md Prerequisites table; verify access; capture timestamps.
step.output: Inputs index with source citations; access blockers surfaced.
step.decision-gate: All inputs reachable? If no -> skip per AGENTS.md Skip If.

step.name: apply-rules
step.action: Walk each rule in `01-core-rules.xml`. Verify each is satisfied. Note violations.
step.decision-gate: Any rule-violation that blocks the methodology? If yes -> skip OR remediate before continuing.

step.name: walk-decision-tree
step.action: Open `06-decision-tree.xml`. Evaluate root question and traverse branches until a `<conclusion>` is reached.
step.output: Decision-record-style note: branch path + conclusion + rule id referenced.
step.decision-gate: Decision = skip-this-methodology? If yes -> log skip reason and exit. Else -> continue.

step.name: draft-artefact
step.action: Draft per `02-output-contract.xml`. Fill schema-required fields. Anchor every non-trivial field to >= 1 evidence entry.
step.output: Draft artefact (JSON or Markdown sidecar matching schema).
step.decision-gate: All required fields populated? Evidence cited? If no -> iterate.

step.name: validate-and-handoff
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-ads-budget-optimization.py --file <artefact>`. Resolve violations. Set status to ready_for_review. Notify named consumer.
step.output: Validator OK + status=ready_for_review + handoff note delivered.
step.decision-gate: Validator exit 0? Consumer acknowledged? If no -> fix and re-validate.

step.name: pacing-check
step.input: Monthly budget, actual spend to date
step.action: Compute expected spend and variance with the pacing formula in `content/05-examples.xml`; adjust daily budgets when variance leaves 0.95-1.05.
step.output: Pacing variance per campaign in the weekly review.
step.decision-gate: Any campaign below 0.95? If yes -> check delivery issues before touching allocation.

step.name: apply-decision-matrix
step.input: Actual CPA vs target CPA per campaign (target from LTV, target-cpa-from-ltv rule)
step.action: Apply the reallocation decision matrix (`content/05-examples.xml`) per campaign; cap every increase at 30% per step and never cut below the learning threshold inside 2 weeks.
step.decision-gate: CPA increase on any scaled campaign above 40%? If yes -> stop scaling it and launch a parallel campaign (stop-scaling-at-40-percent-cpa-increase rule).

step.name: incrementality-before-cut
step.input: Channels proposed for reduction or pause
step.action: Pause the channel for 2 weeks and measure total conversions, not the channel's reported conversions (incrementality-before-cutting-channel rule).
step.output: High / low incrementality verdict per channel.
step.decision-gate: Conversions dropped during the pause? If yes -> keep and optimize; if no -> reallocate.
